description: This file implements an API route handler for recommendations pool, including logic for fetching recommendations, handling multiverse mode, fallbacks, and proxy configuration validation.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Normalizes an unknown value to a trimmed string, handling nullish values.

methods.name: roleIdFromAny
methods.description: Extracts and constructs a role ID string from various possible role object fields.

methods.name: roleTitleFromAny
methods.description: Extracts the role title from various possible role object fields.

methods.name: normalizeRoleForExploreCard
methods.description: Normalizes a role object into a standard shape for explore cards, including ID and title.

methods.name: fetchMultiverseRoles
methods.description: Fetches roles in multiverse mode by querying multiverse graph and path details endpoints.
